shared_elements: tall upright columnar monolith carved in relief
frontal, bilaterally symmetrical composition about a vertical axis
head/face at the top of the shaft
body or shaft covered with relief motifs in stacked horizontal registers
curved horizontal bands crossing the shaft
justification: Both depict a frontal, bilaterally symmetric anthropomorphic pillar with a face at the top and the shaft divided into stacked registers bearing roundels and curved bands, which is a fairly specific shared scheme. However, A is rendered in sparse, flat, schematic low relief with only a few isolated motifs (a plain chest disc, simple banding), while B is a dense, deeply modelled tapestry of interlocking masks, scrolls and volutes with no unfilled ground, and B additionally includes a seated human observer beside the monument.
